thread:
Jason (AE): Heads up team: NorthStar Labs wants a non-standard payment setup before signing. They're a 3-year commit, asking for milestone invoicing and Net60 for the first-year invoices due to their consolidation window. Also asking for a 12% multi-year commitment discount. Need Deal Desk + Finance + Legal to weigh in.

Jason (AE): High level numbers: list value $600k over 3 years. Asking: Year1 invoiced in 3 milestones aligned to delivery (M1: kickoff, M2: production-readiness, M3: post-POC). Year2-3 standard annual billing. Net60 only for Year1 milestones.

Jason (AE): Proposed schedule snippet:
```
M1 (kickoff): $60,000 invoiced on milestone acceptance - Net60
M2 (prod-ready): $120,000 invoiced on milestone acceptance - Net60
M3 (post-POC): $20,000 invoiced on acceptance - Net60
Years 2-3: $200,000 per year, invoiced annually Net30
Discount: 12% applied to Redwood service portion (not professional services) over committed ARR
```

Ivy (Solutions): POC acceptance criteria already agreed in doc. NorthStar insists milestones are tied to internal sign-offs which can delay 30-45 days. We can support milestone gating but need clear acceptance artifacts.

Priya (Deal Desk): Ok. Two flags: 1) Net60 is outside standard AR policy; need Finance sign-off. 2) 12% on a 3-year commit might need pricing committee approval depending on territory.

Omar (Finance): Net60 for Year1 milestones is doable but requires controls: (a) separate milestone invoices; (b) PO# required on each invoice; (c) escrow holdback language? Also tax withholding risk if partner entities involved. We need RevOps to confirm revenue recognition treatment.

Tess (Legal): We'll need contract language: define milestone acceptance, timelines for customer sign-off, dispute resolution, and a clause that delays in customer acceptance don't void Redwood's obligations to invoice. Also add a cap on days payable before interest/late fees.

Jason (AE): Customer explicitly requests Net60 because of their fiscal close cycle. They're okay with PO references. They will not accept any escrow.

Priya (Deal Desk): I'll escalate pricing approval for the 12% multi-year discount. @Omar can you provide an approver note for Finance if you're OK with Net60 conditional rules?

Omar (Finance): Approve Net60 for Year1 milestones subject to: PO# on invoices, milestone acceptance evidence uploaded to contract folder, and AR to perform 7/30/60 collection outreach cadence. Approve discount to be capped at 12% and applied only to subscription fees. Will require RevOps revenue deferral memo.

RevBot: Pricing committee ticket created PC-2026-9002. Approvers requested: Priya, Omar.

Tess (Legal): Drafting milestone invoicing language and payment terms. Will include: "Milestone invoiced upon Customer sign-off; Redwood may invoice without withholding for delays; Net60 applies but non-payment remedies preserved." ETA 36 hours.

Ivy (Solutions): We'll attach acceptance docs and sample sign-off template to the SOW. Jason, please confirm we'll still run the POC in parallel with M1/M2.

Jason (AE): Yes, POC runs in parallel. Customer will sign SOW at execution and accept M1 within 15 business days usually.

Priya (Deal Desk): Noted. If pricing committee approves 12% we need a redline with new payment terms and a Finance approval note embedded in the contract appendix.

Omar (Finance): I'll leave the formal approver note here: "Finance approves Net60 for Year1 milestone invoices contingent on PO# and acceptance artifacts; 12% subscription discount approved for 3-year committed ARR not exceeding $600k; RevOps must prepare revenue deferral memo."

Tess (Legal): Uploaded draft to /contracts/northstar/2026/SOW-milestone-v2. Added milestone acceptance template and payment appendix.

RevBot: Contract workflow status: pricing pending -> pricing approved (PC-2026-9002) at 1768127429.

Jason (AE): Great work. I'll push final redline to the customer and loop in finance@redwood for invoicing. Will update when signed.

Ivy (Solutions): Kicking off parallel POC tomorrow. Will post sign-offs in thread. :rocket:
